title: Session insights
empty: Not enough activity to analyze yet.
degradedTree: Conversation shown as a linear timeline (branch data isn't stored).

costPerCommit.warning: ${cost} per commit across {commits} commit(s) — expensive iterations.

overhead.info: {turns} setup turns before the first real action.
